reason: Training large language models (LLMs) generates diverse coflows within a cluster, requiring optimized scheduling to enhance communication-computation overlap and minimize training time. Existing schedulers inadequately handle contention both across and within coflows, resulting in suboptimal performance. We present Hermod, a comprehensive coflow scheduler that orchestrates all coflow types for LLM training. The key insight behind Hermod is that coflows can be uniquely characterized by three model factors—microbatch ID, coflow type, and layer ID—enabling optimal scheduling decisions. Leveraging this insight, Hermod applies model-factor-driven inter-coflow priority scheduling aligned with the LLM training DAG. Preliminary simulation results show potential for performance improvements.
title: Coflow Scheduling for LLM Training
